import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_product = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors_product)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Revenue by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-right: Sales by Customer Age Group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([age for age in age_order if age in age_sales.index])
colors_age = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_sales_ordered))
axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(age_sales_ordered)), age_sales_ordered.values, color=colors_age, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(age_sales_ordered)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(age_sales_ordered.index, fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue by Customer Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(age_sales_ordered.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v, f'${v:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Bottom-left: Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_payment = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[1, 0].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_payment,
                                            textprops={'fontsize': 10, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontsize(11)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 4. Bottom-right: Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis
takeaway_stats = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({
    'total': 'sum',
    'quantity': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'] = takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})

x_pos = np.arange(len(takeaway_stats))
width = 0.35

bars1 = axes[1, 1].bar(x_pos - width/2, takeaway_stats['total'], width, 
                       label='Total Sales ($)', color='#3498db', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
ax2 = axes[1, 1].twinx()
bars2 = ax2.bar(x_pos + width/2, takeaway_stats['quantity'], width, 
                label='Total Items Sold', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)

axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Order Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#3498db')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Items Sold', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Comparison', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x_pos)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'], fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#3498db')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                    f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
for bar in bars2:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Combine legends
lines1, labels1 = axes[1, 1].get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
axes[1, 1].legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
